audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Darius / Skill / Ornn / Ornn / Darius / Ornn / Ornn. The mirror (darius__ornn) already shipped Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Ornn / Darius / Ornn, so the two directions contradicted each other on five rows — including who wins Level 6.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 but Darius does not need it to win short trades: Hemorrhage stacks and an empowered Decimate out-trade a mana-starved Ornn through level 5. Ornn's genuine flip is Call of the Forge God, and again at two items.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs to agree with the mirror; ratings moved with them, the full whys rewritten, and content whys[3] and whys[5] rewritten so the text no longer claims 'even' on rows now given to Darius.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and phases[5].why were boilerplate; the level-6 line hedged on 'Darius's ultimate'.
audit.why: Call of the Forge God (140s at rank 1) charges and recasts for a second knockup, which is what beats a committed Decimate all-in. The first-item window still belongs to Darius.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to name the spike and its owner.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hemorrhage's five-stack enrage, Decimate's healing, Crippling Strike's empowered-auto tell and Noxian Guillotine's true damage were all absent, and the cooldown block gave no numbers.
audit.why: Hemorrhage stacks five times and enrages him at max stacks, so the pull starting the count is the real cost. Decimate heals off blade hits, which is the anti-heal case. Crippling Strike empowers his next attack on a 5s cooldown — the wind-up is the cue. Noxian Guillotine is true damage scaled by stacks, so armour is the wrong answer.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and all three dontsFull bodies now carry Apprehend's 26s, the 5s Crippling Strike tell, the heal, and the true-damage rule.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Darius's Apprehend is down.
edits.after: No shield yet to answer Apprehend, and his empowered Decimate out-trades your mana-starved kit.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Darius must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Bellows Breath is online, but Hemorrhage stacks plus the Apprehend all-in still edge your shield trade — stabilise.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Apprehend's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 — bait it, then Searing Charge into your pillar. Until it is spent, he still owns the trade.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Darius's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God's charge and recast knockup beat the Decimate all-in — the second ram lands while he is still committed to you.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Apprehend's cooldown.
edits.after: His first item and bleed stacks still win the duel — take Iceborn Gauntlet, but avoid the 1v1.

edits.before: Your second combo point lets you E into your Q-pillar for a knock-up, baiting his pull to make the trade genuinely even.
edits.after: Your second combo point sets up the pillar knockup, but Apprehend at 26s still pulls you into bleed before you land it.

edits.before: Your tank-item spike and W-poke roughly match his bleed-stacking duel — itemization is starting to flip the lane your way.
edits.after: His first item plus Hemorrhage stacks still wins the straight duel — your tank spike only narrows it, so avoid the 1v1.

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — His all-in start. E-knock up after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Apprehend: 26s at rank 1 — his all-in starts there, so step up once it is spent. - Crippling Strike: 5s empowered auto, the wind-up is the tell. - Noxian Guillotine: true damage, 120s at rank 1. - Your R: kill windows only.

edits.before: His all-in start. E-knock up after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 — that spent pull is your whole trading window.

edits.before: That is Darius's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Hemorrhage stacks to five and enrages him — never let the pull start the count.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Decimate heals off its blade — Grievous Wounds before you grind.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks — armour will not save you at five.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind Darius, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.
edits.after: Drop the Q pillar behind Darius, Searing Charge into it for the knockup once Apprehend is spent, then W to Brittle him.

notes: Chart matched to the mirror, which differs from the packet chart on Levels 4-5 and the first-item row (mirror gives both to Darius, packet says Skill); the mirror was followed so the two pages agree.
